about: Local hit-stop (view only; the sim never waits): the attacker and the struck bodies hold, everything else keeps moving. Read by logic/Look/HitStop.cs; classes picked by src/Fx/HitStopClassifier.cs. Milliseconds. A hold never exceeds cap_ms from its start, asking while held extends to the longer remaining (never the sum), and a body cannot be held again for gap_ms after a hold. More than crowd_n living enemies on screen scales every duration by crowd_scale. rate: how fast a held body's clocks run. shake_m/shake_hz: a held enemy's drawn position jitters along the blow, fading to 0 over its hold. catchup_s: the sim motion a held body missed is walked out over this time constant. first_hit_delay_ms: a stop asked by her Oathblade swing lands this long after the blow, so the sweep is up when the frame holds.
